scripts.title: TP for end
scripts.features:
[+] Sequential Auto-Win – Executes a precision teleport sequence through all 10 coordinates, ensuring every checkpoint is registered until the final escape.

[+] God Mode Protection – Neutralizes lethal obstacles like lava and lasers by instantly disabling harmful touch transmitters within your character.

[+] Full Noclip Access – Grants you the ability to walk and fly through walls, doors, and barriers without any collision detection.

[+] Advanced Flight Engine – Features a high-velocity fly mode with a dedicated BodyGyro system for smooth, camera-oriented aerial movement.

[+] Adjustable Fly Velocity – Includes a specialized slider to fine-tune your aerial speed from 10 to 200 for stealthy navigation or rapid travel.

[+] Collision Override – Utilizes a RunService loop to constantly force-disable collisions, ensuring your movement remains unhindered at all times.

[+] Smart Stage Sync – Includes built-in delays between stage teleports to prevent server-side detection and ensure every win is counted.
